blurb:
Experience Nashville’s most iconic, one-of-a-kind party on wheels – the Honky Tonk Party Express, Nashville's only honky tonk on wheels! This isn't just a tour; it's a full-blown dance party, taking you through the heart of downtown Nashville.

Get ready to boot scoot down Broadway in our custom built, open-air party buses. Dance it out on our led light-up dance floor while our DJ plays all your favorite songs. 

VOTED NASHVILLE'S BEST PRE-GAME, enjoy icy cold drinks served by our onboard while our professional party bus driver navigates the streets of downtown Nashville giving you a true Honky Tonk party on wheels!

 - Unique way to experience Nashville in our mobile honky tonk bar

 - 1 hour and 45 minute party Tour
 (Purchase drinks on-site before you board) 

 - Party with up to 25 of your friends. 

 - Load up at our exclusive honky tonk bar - "The Honky Tonk Hideaway" with a full bar, kitchen and Nashville's wildest mechanical bull!

 - 21+ tour
